content:
“Penetrate terminal security with cutting-edge encryption knowledge.”— Perk card description

**Hacker** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk allows to hack locked level 1 terminals throughout Appalachia. It also decreases the lock-out timer by 33%, should an attempt to hack a terminal fail.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain +1 hacking skill, and terminal lock-out time is reduced. | 00356A11 | 

- In order to hack level 2 terminals and above, the Hacker Expert and Hacker Master perks can be equipped alongside this perk.
- As each Hacker perk increases hacking skill by one, they can be equipped in any given combination, and are not tied to a terminal's level. For example, a level 1 terminal can be hacked with Hacker Master equipped, but a level 2 terminal would still require either the Hacker or Hacker Expert perk to be equipped alongside Hacker Master.
- When equipped, the Master Infiltrator legendary perk effectively renders all three Hacker perks obsolete.
